provenance.review: machine-checked by lab.tools.check_registry (verbatim quotes, sections, ids); content reviewed by Claude where noted in review_notes

draft_notes: The requested identifier prefix contains a carriage return, preserved as \r in requirement IDs. The unnumbered introductory provision uses its containing heading title as the section. Section 1 describes purposes restated as operative rules later; section 5 describes prevention objectives without adding distinct requirements. The document-wide dependency list names DKP-1-EPISTEMIC-BOUNDARIES-001, DKP-1-JUSTICE-001, DKP-2-FINANCE-001, DKP-2-ASSETS-001 and DKP-4-CRISIS-001, but does not assign their provisions to individual checks. Only the supplied document was used. Propagation deadlines, escalation semantics and the full epistemic metadata schema are unspecified. Section 7's 'Any modification' requirement must be read alongside its presentation-only correction exception; the boundary of that exception requires a normative-content assessment.

requirements.title: Protocol Override Is Prohibited
requirements.interpretation: Reject an action explicitly classified as overriding this protocol. The text does not define how an override is distinguished from an authorized protocol change.
requirements.criterion: No action overrides this protocol.
requirements.gap: An override is a declared attempt by another protocol; changes through UPGRADE are checked under the finality clause.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how actions are classified as overrides.

requirements.title: Epistemic Protocol Coverage Is Universal
requirements.quote: Applies to all protocols producing or consuming epistemic outputs.
requirements.interpretation: Check that every protocol identified as producing or consuming epistemic outputs falls within this protocol's application. Classification of outputs as epistemic is not defined here.
requirements.criterion: Every producer or consumer of epistemic outputs is included in application_scope.
data_dependencies: protocol interfaces and epistemic output classifications
requirements.gap: A complete protocol inventory and a definition of epistemic outputs are needed. No lab check implemented yet.
hypotheses_needed: Declare which output types are epistemic.

requirements.title: Operational Lifetime Requires Epistemic Validity
requirements.quote: No output remains operational beyond its epistemic validity.
requirements.interpretation: Compare an output's operational status against its supplied epistemic validity at each evaluated time. This checks compliance with validity determinations rather than independently establishing their correctness.
requirements.criterion: An output is not operational at any evaluated time beyond its epistemic validity.
requirements.gap: Validity of the upstream output under H-FC-1.

requirements.title: Epistemic Degradation Propagates Downstream
requirements.interpretation: Trace degradation events through output dependencies and check downstream responses. Section 4.1 specifies responses for listed changes, but this broader invariant does not define every degradation or a propagation deadline.
requirements.criterion: Every epistemic degradation propagates to dependent downstream outputs.
data_dependencies: epistemic state and downstream response histories
requirements.gap: One chain: PTL output → evaluation → asset control and transactions.
hypotheses_needed: Declare which changes count as degradation.
Declare downstream reachability and propagation timing semantics.

requirements.title: Historical Validity Grants No Authority
requirements.quote: No historical VALID state creates persistent authority.
requirements.interpretation: Inspect the provenance of operational authority to identify authority retained because of historical VALID status. The text does not define an authority representation or the boundary between historical and current validity.
requirements.criterion: Historical VALID status does not create persistent authority.
requirements.gap: The §3 invariant read through §4.2: no action on an evaluation made before a later degradation, dispute or loss of consistency.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how persistent authority and historical validity are represented.

requirements.title: State Dependent Enforcement Requires Reevaluation
requirements.quote: Re-evaluation is required for any state-dependent enforcement.
requirements.interpretation: Associate each state-dependent enforcement decision with a re-evaluation record. The text permits readings requiring re-evaluation for each action or only after relevant state changes, without specifying freshness.
requirements.criterion: Every state-dependent enforcement has the required re-evaluation.
requirements.gap: Clear part only: no act on a state changed since its evaluation; per action or per change stays open.
hypotheses_needed: Declare whether re-evaluation is required per action or per relevant state change.

requirements.title: Downgrades Require Downstream Revalidation Flags
requirements.interpretation: For upstream VALID → CONDITIONAL or INVALID, CONSISTENT → ORACLE_CONFLICT, or SUFFICIENT_DATA → DEGRADED_SIGNAL transitions, check that every dependent output sets the flag to TRUE. This tests the transition response without adding a wall-clock deadline.
requirements.criterion: Each listed upstream transition causes revalidation_required = TRUE for all dependent outputs.

requirements.title: Downgrades Suspend Dependent Output Execution
requirements.quote: - enter execution suspension or status quo mode
requirements.interpretation: For each upstream transition listed in section 4.1, check that all dependent outputs enter one of the two permitted modes. This checks the declared mode; section 4.3 separately constrains status quo behavior.
requirements.criterion: Each listed upstream transition places every dependent output in execution suspension or status quo mode.

requirements.title: Downgrades Block Further Enforcement Escalation
requirements.interpretation: Following each upstream transition listed in section 4.1, inspect dependent outputs for further enforcement escalation. A checker needs a declared classification or ordering of enforcement actions.
requirements.criterion: No dependent output further escalates enforcement following a listed upstream transition while the restriction applies.
hypotheses_needed: Declare which enforcement changes constitute escalation.
Declare how section 4.4 re-entry ends the restriction.

requirements.title: Past Validity Cannot Sustain Enforcement
requirements.quote: No enforcement output SHALL remain active solely based on past VALID state if:
requirements.interpretation: When epistemic state degrades, new admissible data arrives, or consistency is lost, reject continued enforcement supported solely by past VALID status. The listed conditions are read as alternative triggers; admissibility and sole reliance need external classifications.
requirements.criterion: If any listed condition holds, an active enforcement output must not rely solely on past VALID status.
requirements.gap: New admissible data = a reading that arrives and changes S(t), or a declared dispute (H-FC-5).
hypotheses_needed: Treat the listed conditions as alternative triggers.
Declare how admissibility and sole reliance are established.

requirements.title: Uncertainty Requires Current State Preservation
requirements.interpretation: During epistemic uncertainty or dispute, compare protected system state with its reference state. The text leaves open whether preservation covers all system state or only enforcement-relevant state, which matters because flags and modes must still change under section 4.1.
requirements.criterion: The current state is preserved throughout epistemic uncertainty or dispute.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the preserved state scope and reference instant.
Declare how uncertainty and dispute intervals are identified.

requirements.title: Uncertainty Requires Enforcement Escalation Halt
requirements.interpretation: Check that escalation ceases during epistemic uncertainty or dispute. This requires declared uncertainty and dispute intervals and an escalation classification.
requirements.criterion: No escalation occurs during epistemic uncertainty or dispute.
hypotheses_needed: Declare uncertainty and dispute detection rules and escalation semantics.

requirements.title: Uncertainty Prevents Penalty Accumulation
requirements.interpretation: Inspect penalty accrual events during epistemic uncertainty or dispute. The text does not specify whether accumulation means gross new accrual or a net increase in a penalty balance.
requirements.criterion: Penalties do not accumulate during epistemic uncertainty or dispute.
hypotheses_needed: Declare uncertainty and dispute intervals.
Declare whether accumulation is measured by accrual events or net balance changes.

requirements.title: Uncertainty Requires Awaiting Deterministic Recomputation
requirements.interpretation: Check that the system remains in its waiting behavior until deterministic recomputation completes. The text does not define the relevant recomputation scope or how determinism is established.
requirements.criterion: The system awaits deterministic recomputation during epistemic uncertainty or dispute.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the relevant recomputation and its determinism test.
Declare which actions are permitted while awaiting recomputation.

requirements.title: Enforcement Reentry Requires Fresh Validated Inputs
requirements.quote:
- new valid output
- full epistemic metadata
- recomputation under updated inputs
requirements.interpretation: At enforcement resumption, require all three listed prerequisites. The text does not supply the metadata schema or precise tests for output newness, validity and updated-input coverage.
requirements.criterion: Enforcement resumes only with a new valid output, full epistemic metadata and recomputation under updated inputs.
hypotheses_needed: Declare the required metadata fields.
Declare how output newness, validity and updated-input coverage are verified.

requirements.title: Previous Outputs Cannot Automatically Reactivate
requirements.interpretation: Check output activation histories for automatic reactivation of previous outputs. Given output identity and activation-cause records, this prohibition can be tested directly.
requirements.criterion: No previous output undergoes automatic reactivation.
data_dependencies: output identity and activation event logs

requirements.title: Later Defects Defeat Historical Correctness Evidence
requirements.quote: Past VALID outputs SHALL NOT be treated as evidence of correctness if later:
requirements.interpretation: If conflict later emerges, data is invalidated, or scope is violated, inspect evidence use for reliance on past VALID outputs as evidence of correctness. The listed conditions are read as alternative triggers, and the rule does not itself assert that the historical output was false.
requirements.criterion: After any listed later defect, past VALID outputs are not used as evidence of correctness.
requirements.gap: Conflict = loss of consistency, invalidation = downgrade or dispute; scope violation is not modelled; evidence use is observed as an action relying on the earlier output.
hypotheses_needed: Treat the listed conditions as alternative triggers.
Declare defect classifications and how evidence use is recorded.

requirements.title: Every Output Remains Open To Reclassification
requirements.quote: All outputs remain subject to epistemic reclassification.
requirements.interpretation: Check that no output is exempt from the epistemic reclassification mechanism. This requires eligibility, without requiring every output to change classification.
requirements.criterion: Every output remains eligible for epistemic reclassification.
requirements.gap: Observed as the dispute_allowed flag of every emitted output.

requirements.title: L8 Tests Downgrade Propagation Correctness
requirements.quote:
L8 MUST test:

- downgrade propagation correctness
requirements.interpretation: Require L8 test evidence addressing correctness of downgrade propagation. The document does not define sufficient test coverage or an acceptance standard.
requirements.criterion: L8 tests downgrade propagation correctness.
data_dependencies: L8 test specifications and execution records
requirements.gap: The lab stands in for L8: the tests run and catch a counterexample.
hypotheses_needed: Declare test adequacy and coverage criteria.

open_point.reason: The requirement binds L8 (DKP-8-SIMULATION), which defines no test adequacy criteria; the lab stands in for L8 and shows only that its own tests run and catch counterexamples.

requirements.title: L8 Tests Enforcement Suspension Behavior
requirements.interpretation: Require L8 test evidence addressing enforcement suspension behavior under the section's MUST-test obligation. Test scenarios and sufficiency criteria are not specified.
requirements.criterion: L8 tests enforcement suspension behavior.
data_dependencies: L8 test specifications and execution records
requirements.gap: The lab stands in for L8: the tests run and catch a counterexample.
hypotheses_needed: Declare test adequacy and coverage criteria.

open_point.reason: As ETRANS-6-01: L8 test adequacy is not defined; the lab stands in for L8.

requirements.title: L8 Tests Epistemic Revalidation Triggers
requirements.interpretation: Require L8 test evidence addressing revalidation triggers under the section's MUST-test obligation. The text does not specify the complete test scenario set.
requirements.criterion: L8 tests revalidation triggers.
data_dependencies: L8 test specifications and execution records
requirements.gap: The lab stands in for L8: the tests run and catch a counterexample.
hypotheses_needed: Declare test adequacy and coverage criteria.

open_point.reason: As ETRANS-6-01: L8 test adequacy is not defined; the lab stands in for L8.

requirements.title: L8 Tests Prevention Of State Persistence
requirements.interpretation: Require L8 test evidence addressing prevention of state persistence. Context suggests prohibited persistence of historical epistemic or enforcement states; interpreting this as preventing all persistence would conflict with section 4.3.
requirements.criterion: L8 tests prevention of state persistence.
data_dependencies: L8 test specifications and execution records
requirements.gap: The lab stands in for L8: the tests run and catch a counterexample.
hypotheses_needed: Declare which state persistence is prohibited.
Declare test adequacy and coverage criteria.

open_point.reason: As ETRANS-6-01: L8 test adequacy is not defined; the lab stands in for L8.

requirements.title: Protocol Changes Require Controlled Upgrade Procedure
requirements.quote: This protocol is changed only through the controlled procedure of DKP-4-UPGRADE-001: proposal, simulation under DKP-8-SIMULATION-001, audit under DKP-8-AUDIT-001, acceptance conditions, activation window and rollback.
requirements.interpretation: Check protocol changes against the named procedure and evidence for each listed component. Presentation-only corrections are separately excepted, and detailed procedural requirements are in documents not supplied.
requirements.criterion: Every protocol change subject to Upgrade follows DKP-4-UPGRADE-001, including the listed simulation, audit, acceptance, activation and rollback components.
requirements.gap: Declared stages of the change; the procedure itself is upgrade_lifecycle.
hypotheses_needed: Supply the referenced procedural requirements.
Declare whether rollback requires a capability, plan or executed action in the relevant change state.

requirements.title: Modifications Require New Protocol Identifiers
requirements.quote:
Any modification requires:

- a new protocol identifier,
requirements.interpretation: For a modification subject to Upgrade, compare its protocol identifier with prior identifiers. The later presentation-only correction exception limits the otherwise broad phrase 'Any modification'.
requirements.criterion: Every modification subject to Upgrade has a new protocol identifier.

requirements.title: Modifications Require Explicit Incompatibility Declarations
requirements.interpretation: Check that a modification subject to Upgrade includes an explicit incompatibility declaration. The text requires the declaration but provides no schema or method for verifying its substantive correctness.
requirements.criterion: Every modification subject to Upgrade includes an explicit incompatibility declaration.

requirements.title: Modifications Require Full System Simulation
requirements.interpretation: Require simulation evidence covering the full system for every modification subject to Upgrade. Compliance with the named simulation protocol cannot be established from this document alone.
requirements.criterion: Every modification subject to Upgrade undergoes full-system simulation under DKP-8-SIMULATION-001.
hypotheses_needed: Supply simulation compliance requirements and declare the full-system boundary.

requirements.title: Modifications Declare Epistemic Boundary Compatibility
requirements.interpretation: Check that every modification subject to Upgrade contains an explicit compatibility declaration naming the specified protocol. This tests the required declaration, not whether compatibility actually holds.
requirements.criterion: Every modification subject to Upgrade explicitly declares compatibility with DKP-1-EPISTEMIC-BOUNDARIES-001.

requirements.title: Presentation Corrections Receive Limited Change Treatment
requirements.quote: Presentation-only corrections that do not change normative content are not Upgrades (DKP-4-UPGRADE-001 §3); they are recorded only by the "Last updated" date of this document.
requirements.interpretation: For corrections established to be presentation-only and normatively unchanged, check that they are not classified as Upgrades and are recorded only through the document's Last updated date. Establishing unchanged normative content requires a decision rule, and the named field may refer to the front matter's last_updated field.
requirements.criterion: Presentation-only corrections with no normative change are not Upgrades and are recorded only by the document's Last updated date.
hypotheses_needed: Declare how presentation-only changes and normative equivalence are determined.
Declare the mapping between Last updated and last_updated.

requirements.title: Published Editions Require Canonical Source Digests
requirements.quote: Edition integrity: the SHA-256 digest of the canonical source of each published edition is listed in `SHA256SUMS.txt` of the canonical repository (github.com/anahronic/World).
requirements.interpretation: For each published edition, compute SHA-256 over its identified canonical source bytes and compare it with the corresponding entry in the specified repository file. This requires a supplied mapping between editions, canonical source bytes and manifest entries.
requirements.criterion: For every published edition, SHA256(canonical_source_bytes) equals its listed digest in SHA256SUMS.txt at github.com/anahronic/World.
requirements.gap: Checked on the pinned commit and on simulated releases, not on the published site.
